viewers.about: Shows the metanode's subtree as a checklist: every node is an item, an item's children are its sub-todos, and the tree's order is the list's order. Checking an item off is setting its done field; a parent shows its children's progress and is never checked by them.
viewers.source: the metanode's whole subtree (set_metanode depth 16, as New Todo List makes it)

fields.name: done
fields.about: The moment the item was checked off, RFC 3339 in UTC; absent while it is not done. Remove the field to uncheck it.

fields.name: due
fields.about: When it is due, as a person types a date; shown as "Today", "Tomorrow" or the date, red once past and not done.
